markets.name: Albania
markets.signal: In 2025, non-life represented 90.99% of premium and compulsory insurance 62.38%. Domestic MTPL contracts grew 6.85%. Iute has also reported that some customers still expect a physical vehicle and paperwork during a digital journey.
markets.read: Motor has a clear need and a familiar purchase. The harder problem may be trusted proof and service, not awareness alone.
validate: Why customers choose digital, branch or paper routes
Proof downloads, print requests and cover-status contacts
Renewal behaviour by channel, carrier and journey version

markets.name: Moldova
markets.signal: In 2025, general insurance represented 96.7% of premium and motor classes 71.6%. The sector average combined operating ratio rose above 100%.
markets.read: Motor is large, but distribution growth can destroy value if claims and carrier economics do not hold.
validate: Price, loss ratio, claims service and capacity by carrier
Contribution after service, payment and exception cost

markets.name: North Macedonia
markets.signal: Official 2024 reporting showed gross written premium growth of 11.32%, insurance penetration of 1.67% of GDP, and 11 non-life insurers.
markets.read: Growth and low penetration create room to test. They do not prove which product, partner or customer moment will work.
validate: Unmet need, current alternative and willingness to pay
Carrier appetite, product gap and distribution terms
Claim experience, service access and trust by segment

markets.name: Bulgaria
markets.signal: As an EU market, insurance distribution follows IDD requirements on needs, transparency, conduct and standardised product information for non-life insurance.
markets.read: Technology can be shared across markets. Product governance, disclosure and the distributor role need a Bulgaria-specific design.
validate: Distributor role, advice boundary and demands-and-needs process
Local IPID, language, consent and complaint requirements
Carrier integration, digital signature and payment rules

markets.name: Ukraine
markets.signal: The NBU reported that MTPL became the largest premium line in 2025. New direct-settlement rules increased the importance of choosing a reliable insurer amid continued market uncertainty.
markets.read: Partner quality, service continuity and clear exclusions are part of the proposition, not backstage details.
validate: Carrier resilience, territorial limits and war-risk exclusions
Document and claim access during disruption
Fallback communication, payments and service ownership
